Black lentils contains a lot of protein, folic acid, low fat, carbohydrates, and lots of fiber and minerals. It is also very calorific and has a low glycemic index, so I can safely consume diabetes because it stabilizes blood sugar levels. Traditionally in sount India this soakedurad dal is grind to form a paste and used as a main ingredients for making Dosa, masala dosa, idli and Dahi Vada. It is also used in making pan fry dishes. To prepare Traditional panjai cuisine from Urad Dal, take soaked dal in closed pan with water and put it on a high flame for 10 minutes and let it partially cook.
